hook.say: South America's ten highest mountains. Six of them crowd one desert!

outro.say: Which would you climb? Comment below!

items.name: Incahuasi
items.say: Ten: Een-kah-wah-see, House of the Inca. 6638 meters.
items.cap: Ten: Incahuasi, House of the Inca. 6,638 meters.

items.name: Cazadero
items.say: Nine: Kah-sah-deh-ro, hiding behind a giant. 6670 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Cazadero, hiding behind a giant. 6,670 meters.

items.name: Mercedario
items.say: Eight: Mer-seh-dah-ree-oh, Aconcagua's quiet neighbor. 6720 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Mercedario, Aconcagua's quiet neighbor. 6,720 meters.

items.name: Llullaillaco
items.say: Seven: Yoo-yai-yah-ko, Inca ruins on its summit. 6739 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Llullaillaco, Inca ruins on its summit. 6,739 meters.

items.name: Tres Cruces
items.say: Six: Trace Croo-sess, the Three Crosses. 6748 meters.
items.cap: Six: Tres Cruces, the Three Crosses. 6,748 meters.

items.name: Cerro Bonete
items.say: Five: Bo-neh-teh, a lonely volcano. 6759 meters.
items.cap: Five: Bonete, a lonely volcano. 6,759 meters.

items.name: Huascarán
items.say: Four: Wahs-kah-rahn, highest peak in the tropics. 6768 meters.
items.cap: Four: Huascarán, highest peak in the tropics. 6,768 meters.

items.name: Monte Pissis
items.say: Three: Pee-sees, a glacier in the desert. 6792 meters.
items.cap: Three: Pissis, a glacier in the desert. 6,792 meters.

items.name: Ojos del Salado
items.say: Two: Oh-hoss del Sah-lah-doe, Earth's highest volcano. 6893 meters.
items.cap: Two: Ojos del Salado, Earth's highest volcano. 6,893 meters.

items.name: Aconcagua
items.say: And number one: Aconcagua! 6961 meters, the highest peak outside Asia.
items.cap: And number one: Aconcagua! 6,961 meters, the highest peak outside Asia.
